answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in river and ocean lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the canyon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 728 impostors cost 506 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
